Chapter 1
Concerning the teaching of the mysteries, which is spoken before the offering. Mysteries for the faithful.
Speak the teaching of the mysteries as follows: He who existed before and will exist, who came, who suffered and died and was buried and rose, released the pangs of death. He who rose from the dead was not alone, having become human through the Holy Spirit, [?] the flesh of Adam together with his soul. He did not abandon his soul to death. Through the Spirit he strengthened Adam and brought him to life.

Chapter 5
Having risen from the dead and gone to Hades, he destroyed death by his death. After rising on the third day, he gave thanks to the Father, saying the sound word of God as follows: He who through the Spirit strengthened Adam and brought him to life.
As Moses and the other prophets said, we too have put our trust in him, and to him we give glory. To him belong glory and might forever and ever. Amen.
